process_area.title: Anti-Bribery, Gifts & Conflict of Interest Management

workflows.name: ABC Policy Maintenance, Risk Assessment & Training

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-update of "updates for regulatory change" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-capture of "enterprise ABC risk assessment" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "HR/Training delivers ABC training to all employees" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-489 (ensure controlled execution — Anti-Bribery, Gifts & Conflict of Interest Management (PA-86.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Outdated policy / untrained staff; mitigated by annual cycle
System Touchpoints: - Policy repository; risk-assessment tracker; LMS certification

steps.activity: Compliance maintains ABC policy aligned with RA 6713 (Code of Conduct), RA 3019 (Anti-Graft), and ISO 37001; updates for regulatory change
Compliance conducts enterprise ABC risk assessment: geographies, government interaction, procurement, licensing, intermediaries
HR/Training delivers ABC training to all employees; certifies high-risk roles (procurement, licensing, government-facing); tracks completion

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "entertainment via register" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "Compliance reviews declaration" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "Compliance logs outcome" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-489 (ensure controlled execution — Anti-Bribery, Gifts & Conflict of Interest Management (PA-86.3).)
- operational: mandatory register and threshold rules; operational: register and threshold rules
Pain Points / Risks: - **Integrity risk**: Undeclared gifts influence decisions; mitigated by mandatory register and threshold rules
System Touchpoints: - Gifts register; approval workflow; trend analytics

steps.activity: Employee declares offered/received gift, hospitality, entertainment via register; flags government-related or above threshold
Compliance reviews declaration; approves nominal/modest gifts per policy; requires return/decline of excessive or government-related gifts
Compliance logs outcome; aggregates register for audit; trends gift patterns by role/supplier

fields.Trigger: Demand for facilitation payment or solicitation by official

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "reports solicitation or facilitation-payment demand via confidential channel…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documents decision" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "files report with Ombudsman/ARTA/PNP where appropriate" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-489 (ensure controlled execution — Anti-Bribery, Gifts & Conflict of Interest Management (PA-86.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Integrity/safety risk**: Unreported solicitation perpetuates corruption; mitigated by confidential channel and protection
System Touchpoints: - Confidential reporting channel; case file; agency reporting

steps.activity: Employee reports solicitation or facilitation-payment demand via confidential channel within 24 hours
Compliance/Legal evaluates: legality, safety, alternatives; documents decision (decline, escalate, report to Ombudsman/ARTA)
Compliance files report with Ombudsman/ARTA/PNP where appropriate; protects employee from retaliation; tracks resolution

fields.Trigger: Annual cycle + trigger event (new role, relationship)

workflows.name: Conflict of Interest Disclosure & Annual Declaration

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "Manager/Compliance reviews disclosures" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "updates on trigger events" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-489 (ensure controlled execution — Anti-Bribery, Gifts & Conflict of Interest Management (PA-86.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Integrity risk**: Undisclosed conflict biases decisions; mitigated by annual declaration and detection
System Touchpoints: - COI disclosure system; mitigation tracker; register

steps.activity: Employee completes annual COI disclosure: outside employment, family relationships with employees/vendors/customers, financial interests
Manager/Compliance reviews disclosures; mitigates conflicts (reassignment, recusal, divestiture); documents resolution
HR/Compliance maintains COI register; updates on trigger events; flags undisclosed conflicts detected elsewhere

fields.Participants: VP Legal & Compliance, Regulatory Officer, Store Manager, Legal

workflows.name: Government Interaction, Public Official Engagement & Procurement Integrity

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "log, no improper benefit" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-inspect of "Regulatory Officer/Store Manager logs every government interaction" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "Legal ensures procurement integrity" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-489 (ensure controlled execution — Anti-Bribery, Gifts & Conflict of Interest Management (PA-86.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Legal risk**: Improper government interaction violates anti-graft law; mitigated by protocol and logging
System Touchpoints: - Government interaction log; payment receipt archive; B2G procurement tracker

steps.activity: Compliance maintains protocol for government interactions: designated spokesperson, interaction log, no improper benefit
Regulatory Officer/Store Manager logs every government interaction (permit, inspection, inquiry); obtains receipt for any payment
Legal ensures procurement integrity (RA 9184 interface) for B2G sales: no bribery, transparent bidding, documented commissions

workflows.name: Third-Party Intermediary (Agent/Consultant) Due Diligence & ABC Controls

Automation Opportunity: - System continuous audit of "audit rights, and termination-for-bribery provision" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitors intermediary activity for red flags" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-489 (ensure controlled execution — Anti-Bribery, Gifts & Conflict of Interest Management (PA-86.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Liability risk**: Intermediary bribery imputed to company; mitigated by EDD and contractual protection
System Touchpoints: - Intermediary due-diligence file; agreement template with ABC clauses; monitoring

steps.activity: Compliance performs enhanced due diligence on intermediaries: ownership, reputation, government connections, commission reasonableness
Legal structures agreement with ABC clauses, audit rights, and termination-for-bribery provision
Compliance monitors intermediary activity for red flags (unusual commission, government connection); audits periodically

fields.Trigger: Whistleblower report or detection of ABC violation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "Internal Audit/Compliance investigates alleged ABC violation" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "Legal/Compliance determines disciplinary action" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks prevention effectiveness" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-489 (ensure controlled execution — Anti-Bribery, Gifts & Conflict of Interest Management (PA-86.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reputational risk**: Unaddressed violation damages brand; mitigated by rigorous investigation and remediation
System Touchpoints: - Investigation case file; whistleblower protection; remediation tracker

steps.activity: Internal Audit/Compliance investigates alleged ABC violation: evidence collection, interviews, transaction review
Legal/Compliance determines disciplinary action (termination), self-reporting (Ombudsman/AMLC), and restitution
Compliance remediates root cause (policy, training, controls); reports to Audit Committee; tracks prevention effectiveness

workflows.name: ABC Program Assurance, Metrics & Board Reporting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-compile of "compiles ABC program metrics" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews ABC program effectiveness annually" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "Compliance reports program posture to Audit Committee/Board" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-489 (ensure controlled execution — Anti-Bribery, Gifts & Conflict of Interest Management (PA-86.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Governance risk**: Unmeasured program effectiveness; mitigated by metrics and audit assurance
System Touchpoints: - ABC metrics dashboard; audit evidence; board reporting

steps.activity: Compliance compiles ABC program metrics: training completion, gift declarations, solicitations reported, investigations, remediation
Internal Audit reviews ABC program effectiveness annually (W159 linkage); validates controls; identifies gaps
Compliance reports program posture to Audit Committee/Board; recommends enhancements; tracks commitments
